section_summary.extract_value: This section reports sex invariance testing for a single study, presenting results for female (n = 112) and male (n = 141) subsamples. Factor loading invariance across sex was supported, but intercept invariance was not supported, and therefore sex differences in mean scores were not evaluated.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The unconstrained model had adequate fit in the female subsample (n = 112)... However, the unconstrained model had poor-to-adequate fit in the male subsample (n = 141)." "Differences between the unconstrained and fully constrained model were not significant... indicating that the structure of the model achieved factor loading invariance across sex..." "According to the -2, intercept invariance was not supported, -2(10) = 38.389, p < .001... Overall, these data suggest that measurement invariance was not fully achieved, so sex differences in mean scores were not evaluated."
